company.name: Archbee
company.shortDescription: Archbee is a product documentation platform that provides a docs tool for software teams and products.
company.description: Archbee provides a collaborative platform for companies to create and host professional, searchable knowledge portals. It enables teams to write, organize, and publish technical documentation, featuring AI-powered search, developer-focused tools, and seamless integration with existing tech stacks.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,922,135 to $14,920,947, a 2.16x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
